testcase.name: Scenario: Resize ribbon customization while a command is staged: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1754:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resize ribbon customization while a command is staged ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and ribbon customization is open with an empty Part Tools target ✔ And All Commands is shown in the available-command list ✔ When the user drags the lower-right dialog corner outward ✔ Then the dialog and both command lists become wider and taller ✔ And more available-command rows are visible ✔ When the user adds 2D Sketches to the custom-panel target ✔ Then the target shows 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And the target selector indicates a pending change ✔ When the user drags the lower-right dialog corner inward ✔ Then the dialog and both command lists become smaller ✔ And the staged 2D Sketches row and its unchecked options remain visible ✔ And the target selector still indicates a pending change ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the dialog closes without applying the staged command
